summary: The candidate fixes ordinary late-prefill KV allocation exception propagation and request-slot cleanup, but mishandles an existing chunked prefill: after a late allocation miss the same request remains Scheduler.chunked_req and is also appended to waiting_queue. This leaves duplicate scheduler ownership and a next-pass double-admission path, so the original graceful-recovery contract is only partially resolved.

tests.what_was_measured: On recorded base, an issue-shaped injected late allocation miss escaped the real Scheduler._get_new_batch_prefill_raw call as RuntimeError. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/base/scheduler_requeue.log

On recorded base, the pre-existing request-slot boundary passed but the newly acquired request slot remained allocated after a real paged alloc_extend None result. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/base/allocation_cleanup.log

At exact candidate commit, the candidate's focused scheduler, allocation ownership, and Mamba admission tests passed: 34 tests and 12 subtests. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/candidate/candidate_tests.log

At exact candidate commit, an existing chunked request remained Scheduler.chunked_req and was also appended to waiting_queue after a late KV allocation miss. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/candidate/adversarial.log

gpu_execution.evidence: Only device inventory was inspected: one AMD Instinct MI350X with gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, ROCm 7.2.26015. The reviewed changes and deterministic tests are CPU scheduler/control flow; no GPU numerical result is claimed.

remaining_counterexamples: When Scheduler.chunked_req already references an active chunked prefill and prepare_for_extend raises KVCacheOOMError, the candidate decrements its inflight counter but retains Scheduler.chunked_req and also sends that same request through _add_request_to_queue. The next pass can admit the same object via add_chunked_req and the ordinary waiting_queue loop.
remaining_limitations: The exact Kimi-K3 TP8/DCP4 sustained-traffic reproduction was not run because the job provides one AMD gfx950 GPU rather than eight NVIDIA B300 GPUs and no Kimi-K3 weights.
The tiny Llama fixture cannot exercise the hybrid Mamba allocator and was not treated as evidence for this issue.
No GPU execution or distributed-model behavior was validated; the review establishes deterministic scheduler and allocator control-flow behavior only.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes no native source.
